links.comparator_used: Original, unsimplified CT report impressions given to patients
links.outcome: Patient knowledge of primary site and disease extent, and confidence and understanding of the report
links.effect: Simplified report group had significantly better knowledge of primary site and extent of disease and significantly higher confidence and understanding (P < .05 for all); 100 patients randomized to two groups
links.tradeoff: Radiologist supervision was needed; 3 of 50 simplified reports required corrections by the radiologist.
links.quote: In phase II, simplified report group patients demonstrated significantly better knowledge of primary site and extent of their disease as well as showed significantly higher confidence and understanding of the report (P < .05 for all).

design_hint: LLM-simplified reports with radiologist review and reading-level prompt
